headline: Adani Enterprises Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of 50% stake of Monvarex Aluminium Holding RSC Ltd. by Adani Global Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company
